elements.name: Magical Evasion
elements.desc: When you would fail a saving throw against a spell effect, you can choose to succeed instead. You can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: False Form
elements.desc: As an arachi, you possess two forms: a true form and a false form. Your false form appears as a member of your origin race and can look however you wish. Once you choose this appearance, it can never be changed. You can change between your false form and true form as an action. Nothing aside from your physical appearance changes. However, while in your false form, you gain advantage on Deception checks related to concealing your true nature as an arachi or to actions you performed while you were in your true form.

elements.name: Blood of the Spider
elements.desc: Arachi possess a remarkable resistance to poison, and it flows through their fangs with equal ease. You gain resistance to poison damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, you gain the ability to cast falling spider’s spite at 1st level once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

elements.name: Falling Spider’s Spite Spell
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: poison resistance from a class feature

You gain the ability to cast falling spider’s spite at 1st level once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

elements.name: Remarkably Forgetful
elements.desc: You learn the forget cantrip, and you can cast it on yourself multiple times instead of only once, forgetting a total number of different things up to your character level.

elements.name: Gift of Ash
elements.desc: Ashenspawn are blessed with an exceptional resistance to flame, as it fills their form with power and might. You gain resistance to fire damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, your inner power awakens, granting you the ability to cast the scorch cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Scorch Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: fire resistance from a class feature

You learn the scorch cantrip instead. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Flaming Feast
elements.desc: Thanks to your relation to the Wolf, you can easily consume wood, metal, and raw meat without harm, and they provide you with sustenance. You can eat nonmagical wood and metal at the same rate you could consume normal food as your jaws and teeth are strong enough to allow you to bite through iron if you can get your mouth around it. Stronger metals are tough and may take several minutes to bite through, depending on their thickness. Magical metals are too durable for ashenspawn to consume using this feature. Eating metal produces a terrible screeching sound that can be easily heard up to 150 feet away.

elements.name: Durable Mind (Groveborn)
elements.desc: You gain resistance to psychic damage.

elements.name: Guise of the Grove
elements.desc: You can take the Hide action to conceal yourself even when you are only lightly obscured so long as you are concealed by plants, such as trees, bushes, or tall grass.

elements.name: Sundrinker
elements.desc: If you are exposed to sunlight for at least 1 hour, you do not need food or water for the day. You can drink the blood of other creatures in place of eating or drinking without ill effect, and the blood of a single Small creature will sustain you for one day. A Medium creature could sustain you for three days, while a Large creature’s entire supply of blood could sustain you for one week or more.

elements.name: Scarred By The Storm
elements.desc: You gain resistance to lightning damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, you gain the ability to cast shocking grasp. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

elements.name: Shocking Grasp Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: lightning resistance from a class feature

You learn the shocking grasp cantrip instead. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Soul Ignition
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can ignite your soul, forcing it to appear as wings of mist and lightning until the start of your next turn and causing you to immediately take 6 radiant damage. During this time, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. If you do not repeat this process to maintain your flight at the start of your next turn, you will fall.

elements.name: Venomous Blessing
elements.desc: You gain resistance to poison damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, your inner power awakens, granting you the ability to cast the poison spray cantrip. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Poison Spray Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: poison resistance from a class feature

You learn the poison spray cantrip instead. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Viper Fangs
elements.desc: You can choose to have your unarmed strikes deal poison damage instead of bludgeoning damage.

elements.name: Forked Tongue
elements.desc: You can add your Wisdom modifier to Deception checks in place of your Charisma modifier.

elements.name: Form Supression
elements.desc: You can conceal your serpentine traits as an action by focusing your will, as though you were maintaining concentration on a spell.

elements.name: Starborn
elements.desc: You gain resistance to radiant damage.

elements.name: Mystical Power
elements.desc: Choose a cantrip from the cleric, wizard, or bard spell list. You learn this cantrip, and you can cast it using either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).

elements.name: Constellation
elements.desc: You have been marked by a particular constellation and gain a benefit based on your racial origin that applies whenever you cast a cantrip as an action.

elements.name: Constellation of the Slayer
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. Your next successful weapon attack deals an extra 1d4 damage of the same type as your breath weapon, provided you do not make it during this turn.

elements.name: Constellation of the Wanderer
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. If you take the Attack action during your next turn and target a creature, your speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

elements.name: Constellation of the Devourer
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. If you make an opportunity attack before the start of your next turn, you can pursue the target as it moves away from you. Match its movement, up to 30 feet in total, whenever the target moves during its turn.

elements.name: Constellation of the Skulker
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. If you take the Hide action before the end of your next turn, you gain advantage on the check.

elements.name: Constellation of the Champion
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. If the cantrip deals damage and has a duration of “Instantaneous”, you gain resistance to one damage type dealt by the cantrip until the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Constellation of the Scholar
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. If the cantrip can’t deal damage, you gain advantage on the first melee attack during your next turn.

elements.name: Constellation of the Heartless
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. The first time you make an attack before the end of your next turn targeting a creature that is charmed or frightened by you, you gain advantage on the attack.

elements.name: Constellation of the Overseer
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip as an action. You can take the Search action as a bonus action this turn. If you do, you know the location of any creature within 30 feet of you who attacks or casts a spell before the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Black Blood
elements.desc: Your blood is cursed and it marks everything it touches. You gain resistance to necrotic damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, you learn the shadowthorn cantrip instead. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Shadowthorn Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: necrotic resistance from a class feature

You learn the shadowthorn cantrip instead. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Madness
elements.desc: Your insanity makes it difficult for others to discern your true intentions. Creatures that make Insight checks against you do so with disadvantage.

elements.name: Quill Claws
elements.desc: Your fingers are deadly implements that drip with black ink-blood. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal necrotic damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Night Terrors
elements.desc: You gain resistance to psychic damage and proficiency in the Perception skill.

elements.name: Perpetual Insomnia
elements.desc: You desire and fear sleep in equal measure. Whenever you take a long rest, you can choose to remain awake or try to sleep. If you remain awake, you gain advantage on Charisma saving throws, and you can perform light activity, such as keeping watch, to gain the benefits of a long rest. If you sleep, your movement speed and jumping height each increase by 5 feet, but you suffer disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened. These benefits last until you begin a new long rest. If you gain the ability to go without sleep, you gain all the benefits and no penalties.

elements.name: Nine Lives
elements.desc: You’re hard to kill, but only when your fate is unknown. Whenever you are hidden from all other creatures, you gain advantage on death saving throws and on saving throws to reduce damage.

elements.name: Restless
elements.desc: You do not suffer exhaustion when you go without sleep for extended periods of time, but you must still rest as normal.

elements.name: Acidic Body
elements.desc: You gain resistance to acid damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, your inner power awakens, granting you the ability to cast the acid splash cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip. You are immune to acid damage caused by friendly oozes.

elements.name: Acid Splash Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: acid resistance from a class feature

You learn the acid splash cantrip instead. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip. You are also immune to acid damage caused by friendly oozes.

elements.name: Jiggly Self
elements.desc: You have resistance to falling damage, and you are not knocked prone when you take falling damage.

elements.name: Limitless Cheer
elements.desc: You can add your Charisma modifier to saving throws against being frightened.

elements.name: Durable Mind (Statuesque)
elements.desc: You gain resistance to radiant damage. If you would also gain this resistance from a class feature, your inner power awakens, granting you the ability to cast the mending cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Mending Cantrip
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: radiant resistance from a class feature

You learn the mending cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.

elements.name: Natural Soul
elements.desc: Your form is incredibly durable, thanks to your immortal composition. Whenever you take damage, you can choose to reduce the damage taken by 1. This reduction is applied after resistances or vulnerabilities.

elements.name: +2 Dexterity, +1 Charisma (Arachi)
elements.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

elements.name: +2 Charisma, +1 Dexterity (Arachi)
elements.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, and your Charisma score increases by 2.

elements.name: Dragonborn (Arachi)
elements.desc: While the dragon blood that flows through your veins remains potent and powerful, it has been greatly changed by the influence of the Alrisen upon your bloodline. You gain the Draconic Ancestry and Breath Weapon racial features, but do not gain the Damage Resistance feature or any other racial features. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Dwarf (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain the Dwarven Toughness racial feature and you gain darkvision out to 30 feet. Your base walking speed is 25 feet, your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Elf (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain the Darkvision, Fey Ancestry, and Trance racial features of an elf. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Gnome (Arachi)
elements.desc: When you would fail a saving throw against a spell effect, you can choose to succeed instead. You can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest. You also gain the Darkvision racial feature of a gnome. Your base walking speed is 25 feet, and your size is Small.

elements.name: Human (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choosing and one language of your choosing. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Half-Elf (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choosing and one language of your choosing. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Halfling (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain the Lucky, Brave and Halfling Nimbleness racial features. Your base walking speed is 25 feet, and your size is Small.

elements.name: Half-Orc (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain the Relentless Endurance and Darkvision racial features. Your speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.

elements.name: Tiefling (Arachi)
elements.desc: You gain the Infernal Legacy racial feature. Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and your size is Medium.
